paragraphs.source_en: At these words from her two elder brothers, Lady Asahi began to laugh. paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi was a man capable of ruling the realm, yet his only younger sister left him at a loss. Was Ieyasu, whom his sister was to marry, also a man who would prove difficult for him to handle? His anger was directed not only at Lady Asahi but at Ieyasu as well.

paragraphs.source_en: Seeing Hideyoshi standing outside, Lady Asahi's maid hurried into the dim corridor to receive him. paragraphs.source_en: A man might devote himself wholly to the realm, only to be thought possessed of “coldhearted ambition.” Such a clash of understanding was by no means a conflict between ruler and ruled, but a discord of feeling between one human being and another. paragraphs.source_en: Daughters often resembled their fathers, perhaps. Their father, Chikuami, had been an indecisive man.
